title: dHEDGE V2 Error Registry
description: Canonical, machine-generated registry of decodable smart contract error identifiers (require/revert string reverts and custom Solidity error selectors) with human-facing description/action copy. Generated from contracts/ - do not hand-edit; edit readmes/errorCodes/overlay.json instead and run `pnpm error-registry:generate`.

schemaVersion.description: Bumped only when this schema's shape changes, not when entries change.

stringErrors.description: Keyed by the exact literal string reverted via require(cond, "...") or revert("..."). Decode by matching the ABI-decoded Error(string) revert reason against this map.

selectorErrors.description: Keyed by the 4-byte custom error selector (0x-prefixed, lowercase hex). Decode by taking the first 4 bytes of the revert data and matching against this map.

source.description: Repo-relative source file(s) where this error is used/declared.

curated.description: False when description/action are generic fallback copy, not yet human-reviewed.
